pages.title: She Counts the Dying
pages.text: Aurelia's Faith Altar keeps no garden - it counts whatever falls near enough instead, by any hand, and earns you Faith for each. It isn't picky about whose kill it was.

pages.title: What She Grants
pages.text: Pledged to her, Strength settles over you permanently, deepening the longer you've kept faith with her since your last pledge. Push that devotion far enough and, once, she'll pull you back from a killing blow rather than let you fall - though not again for a good while after.
